Materials and Construction

The hand-laid carbon fiber shell is the centerpiece of this helmet, delivering an extraordinary strength-to-weight ratio that race teams demand. Each shell is precision-molded to ensure consistent thickness and structural integrity, providing race-grade impact protection while keeping the helmet noticeably lighter than composite alternatives. The carbon weave pattern visible through the clear coat is not just aesthetic; it is a testament to the authentic construction method that defines premium helmet manufacturing.

The shell geometry has been wind-tunnel tested to minimize turbulence and drag, while the aerodynamic profile reduces neck fatigue during extended rides. Every contour serves a purpose, from the integrated spoiler that stabilizes the helmet at high speed to the carefully sculpted chin bar that optimizes airflow without compromising structural integrity.

Safety and Certification

This helmet carries ECE 22.06 & FIM Homologated certification, the highest protection level recognized in professional motorcycle racing. The FIM homologation certifies defense against dangerous rotational accelerations, going beyond standard ECE requirements. The multi-density EPS liner uses at least three different foam densities strategically positioned to handle impacts from different angles and at varying speeds. The result is a helmet that protects against both direct impacts and the rotational forces that cause the most serious brain injuries.

The impact absorption system uses strategically placed foam densities that respond differently depending on impact severity, providing progressive deceleration that reduces peak forces transmitted to the rider. This approach mirrors the technology used in professional racing helmets, adapted for street riding conditions where impacts can occur at varying angles and speeds.

Visor and Visibility

The 190-degree horizontal and 85-degree vertical field of view visor provides maximum situational awareness, letting you see the road, hazards, and traffic before they become problems. An included Pinlock 120 anti-fog insert ensures crystal-clear vision in cold and humid conditions, eliminating the dangerous visor fogging that compromises rider safety. The scratch-resistant coating maintains optical clarity through thousands of open-close cycles, and the quick-release mechanism allows tool-free visor swaps in seconds. The visor meets optical class 1 standards, meaning zero distortion across the entire viewing area for accurate distance and speed judgment.

The visor mechanism operates with a satisfying click that confirms secure closure, while the quick-release system allows tool-free swaps in seconds. The optical clarity meets optical class 1 standards, meaning zero distortion across the entire field of view, which is critical for judging distances and speeds in traffic.

Comfort and Interior

The Pista GP RR interior system uses premium fabrics that cradle your head in plush comfort for hours of fatigue-free riding. All interior components are fully removable and machine-washable for easy hygiene maintenance. The 3D-shaped cheek pads conform to your facial contours, while the crown pad provides even pressure distribution that eliminates hot spots. The fit is designed to accommodate riders who wear glasses, with dedicated channels that prevent temple pressure points.

All interior materials are hypoallergenic and treated with antimicrobial agents to maintain freshness between washes. The removable cheek pads allow fine-tuning of the fit, and replacement interiors are available in various thicknesses to accommodate different head shapes.

Ventilation System

The Pista GP RR ventilation system channels cool, fresh air across the helmet interior through strategically placed intake vents, while rear exhaust ports efficiently remove hot, humid air using the Venturi effect. The result is a continuously refreshed interior environment that keeps you comfortable during intense summer sessions or extended highway cruising. The vent covers operate with positive-click mechanisms that allow precise airflow adjustment even while wearing gloves.

The ventilation system is designed to work across all seasons. In summer, the full open configuration delivers maximum cooling airflow. In cooler conditions, vents can be partially closed to retain warmth while still providing fresh air circulation. The exhaust ports use the Venturi effect to actively pull hot air out of the helmet, creating continuous air exchange even at moderate speeds.

Intended Rider Profile

Designed for track riders and racing enthusiasts who demand the absolute pinnacle of helmet performance. This helmet meets the stringent requirements of professional competition while remaining practical enough for spirited street riding. Ideal for riders who push their limits and need equipment that keeps pace.

Product Overview

The AGV K6 S Black Helmet is AGV's answer to riders who demand uncompromising protection paired with all-day comfort. Every element of this K6 S helmet has been refined through AGV's decades of racing heritage and real-world testing, resulting in a lid that performs whether you are carving through mountain passes, commuting through city traffic, or pushing your limits on the track. Available now at Mile 27 Store with free shipping across India and genuine product guarantee.

Key Features

  • Composite Fibre
  • Wind protector
  • Integrated spoiler
  • Optimized for all riding positions
  • Shell shape designed to reduce turbulence
  • Cheek pads safety release system
  • Cheek pads: Ritmo fabric to facilitate putting on/taking off the helmet, with cheekbone area in Shalimar fabric to ensure stability at high speed
  • Crown pad: Shalimar fabric for a soft and gentle touch
  • DrySpeed: instant sweat absorption
  • Embracing neck roll profile
  • Fit especially designed to allow wearing glasses
  • Microsense: premium skin comfort
  • AGV K6 S Helmet
  • Pinlock anti-fog insert
  • User manual & warranty card

Materials and Construction

The composite shell combines carbon fiber, aramid, and fiberglass in a carefully engineered layup that optimizes impact resistance across different zones. Carbon provides rigidity and lightweight properties, aramid adds puncture and penetration resistance, and fiberglass contributes flexibility and energy absorption. This tri-material approach creates a shell that performs consistently across a wider range of impact scenarios than any single material could achieve alone.

The shell geometry has been wind-tunnel tested to minimize turbulence and drag, while the aerodynamic profile reduces neck fatigue during extended rides. Every contour serves a purpose, from the integrated spoiler that stabilizes the helmet at high speed to the carefully sculpted chin bar that optimizes airflow without compromising structural integrity.

Safety and Certification

This helmet meets ECE 22.06 certification, the latest and most rigorous European safety standard for motorcycle helmets. The carbon/aramid fiber shell is engineered for optimal impact energy distribution, with a multi-density EPS liner providing progressive absorption across different impact zones. The collarbone-safe profile design reduces the risk of collarbone injuries in the event of a forward fall, addressing one of the most common and serious motorcycle injuries.

The impact absorption system uses strategically placed foam densities that respond differently depending on impact severity, providing progressive deceleration that reduces peak forces transmitted to the rider. This approach mirrors the technology used in professional racing helmets, adapted for street riding conditions where impacts can occur at varying angles and speeds.

Visor and Visibility

The extraordinarily wide field of view visor provides maximum situational awareness, letting you see the road, hazards, and traffic before they become problems. An included Pinlock 120 anti-fog insert ensures crystal-clear vision in cold and humid conditions, eliminating the dangerous visor fogging that compromises rider safety. The scratch-resistant coating maintains optical clarity through thousands of open-close cycles, and the quick-release mechanism allows tool-free visor swaps in seconds. The visor meets optical class 1 standards, meaning zero distortion across the entire viewing area for accurate distance and speed judgment.

The visor mechanism operates with a satisfying click that confirms secure closure, while the quick-release system allows tool-free swaps in seconds. The optical clarity meets optical class 1 standards, meaning zero distortion across the entire field of view, which is critical for judging distances and speeds in traffic.

Comfort and Interior

The K6 S interior system uses premium fabrics that cradle your head in plush comfort for hours of fatigue-free riding. All interior components are fully removable and machine-washable for easy hygiene maintenance. The 3D-shaped cheek pads conform to your facial contours, while the crown pad provides even pressure distribution that eliminates hot spots. The fit is designed to accommodate riders who wear glasses, with dedicated channels that prevent temple pressure points.

All interior materials are hypoallergenic and treated with antimicrobial agents to maintain freshness between washes. The removable cheek pads allow fine-tuning of the fit, and replacement interiors are available in various thicknesses to accommodate different head shapes.

Ventilation System

The K6 S ventilation system channels cool, fresh air across the helmet interior through strategically placed intake vents, while rear exhaust ports efficiently remove hot, humid air using the Venturi effect. The result is a continuously refreshed interior environment that keeps you comfortable during intense summer sessions or extended highway cruising. The vent covers operate with positive-click mechanisms that allow precise airflow adjustment even while wearing gloves.

The ventilation system is designed to work across all seasons. In summer, the full open configuration delivers maximum cooling airflow. In cooler conditions, vents can be partially closed to retain warmth while still providing fresh air circulation. The exhaust ports use the Venturi effect to actively pull hot air out of the helmet, creating continuous air exchange even at moderate speeds.

Intended Rider Profile

Suitable for daily commuters, weekend warriors, and touring riders who want reliable protection and all-day comfort without compromise.
